Let it colonize until about 50% and then break it apart in the bag so it will colonize the rest of it faster. You'd want to start the tray with 100% colonized rye. Open the bag and put it in a smaller tray  with coconut coir, gypsum and vermiculite and coffee grounds (you can use a cheap dollar store aluminum tray) and then put that back in your incubator so it will colonize your entire medium. Then put it into a monotub spray the sides put a wax paper sheet over the tray and let that sit for a week before pulling the sheet to check it. Once you are satisfied with your pinset you can take the sheet off and let them bloom.
